appearance_facts.fact: Bold black serif title reads 'City Emissions Reduction by Program'. The y-axis label at upper left, y~160-180, reads 'Reported reduction share (%)'. The y-axis scale runs from 0 to 70 in increments of 5, with tick labels at x~140-160. Five vertical bars are arranged left-to-right along the x-axis, each with a bold percentage annotation above it. The bars have distinct colors: green (leftmost), light blue (second), purple-blue (middle), dark green (fourth), and brown (rightmost). The light blue bar (second from left) is the tallest, reaching near the 70 mark. The green bar (first) is the second tallest, reaching just above 40. The purple-blue bar (third) reaches just above 50. The dark green bar (fourth) is the shortest, reaching just above 20. The brown bar (fifth) reaches just above 35. The x-axis labels are positioned below each bar at y~900-960.

public_definitions: The task requires identifying the 'emissions-reduction program with the largest contribution' from the dashboard. The 'Routing basis' is specified as 'Largest city emissions-reduction contribution program'. The 'Escalation queue' is 'Accelerated program review'. The available options are: 'Route Building retrofits to accelerated program review', 'Route Transit electrification to accelerated program review', and 'Keep Industrial efficiency in routine program monitoring'.
